Bettina, I set up the Monday 08:00 Chicago-time "Coastal week ahead" digest, but it won't run yet and the first run is dated wrong.

- **Gateway not running:** the scheduler's gateway is off, so nothing will fire until someone starts it. I can't start it from here.
- **Wrong first date:** the scheduler uses the system clock, which says today is Oct 23. It shows the first run as Mon 26 Oct. You asked for Mon 19 Oct, the next Monday after today's date of Oct 14, so that run will be missed.
- **Delivery:** the job runs with local-only delivery, and I couldn't verify that it can post into #coastal-team.

Each run reads last week's messages in #coastal-team and #coastal-random only. It posts one digest in #coastal-team covering last week and open customer items.

I replied in your thread in #coastal-team with the same caveats and offered to post a one-off digest now. I haven't posted a digest yet.
